description: T1780 | Compatible 4-State CCLS Models for Use in Fragility Analysis of Bridges & Seat Abutments in California Bridges is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by CS Walter Yang, Georgia Institute of Technology (gatech.edu). This project provides component capacity limit state (CCLS) benchmark values for uniform comparison of component fragilities associated with the various abutment backwall modeling schemes. The bridge components considered in this project include columns, pier wall, piles, shafts, bearings, strip seal, and unseating. Photos of the corresponding damage states of each bridge component have been collected. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: Capacity Limit States; Damage States; Fragility; Bridges; Components; Columns; Piles; Bearings; Strip Seal; Seat Abutments; California Bridges. Published 2020-11-27. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
